_comment: recognition_2, TODO §14 -- gislr.1.pipeline.stage1-rules.ipynb. Every tunable of the rule engine lives here, never in a cell. Units: lengths/velocities are multiples of inter-eye distance (no pose, so no shoulder width); angles in degrees. Retuned 2026-09-27 after analyzing the first full run's confusions (see TODO §14): spread_t 12->20 (was over-triggering spread=1, 478 pred vs 266 true), amp_t 0.08->0.04 and apt_amp_t (new) 0.15 (repeated_movement recall was 13% on true repeats), flat_base_t 40->25 (two known Flat-truth glosses measured base flexion 28-42, both missed at 40).
